question: Which classes of beings are included among those seeking this teaching?
premises: Gandharvas, kinnaras, and yakshas are mentioned
Asuras and ascetics are also included
inference: Various divine, semi-divine, and ascetic beings are among the seekers
uncertainties: garndhavāḥ appears to be a nonstandard spelling of gandharvāḥ
plain_english: Gandharvas, kinnaras, yakshas, asuras, and ascetics.
